In this case, a detailed accident report was filed by police in terms of provisions of Motor Vehicle Act and same is treated as Claim Petition in view of the provisions contained in such Act. 2. As per the investigation by the police officials on 17.12.2018, concerned police officials on receiving of a Pcr call vide Dd no. 34A regarding an accident with offending vehicle no. Dl 3Cbu 3021, reached the spot where they found dak van no. Dl 3Cbu 3021 and Motorcycle no. Up 22F 7642 make Bajaj Platina in accidental condition. The concerned police official took photographs of the accident spot. They also came to know that the injured was already taken to hospital by the offending vehicle driver. The police officials reached the hospital and collected the Mlc of injured. They found the driver of offending vehicle who confirmed that the said accident took place with his vehicle no. Dl 3Cbu 3021. 3. The police officials also took statement of injured wherein he stated that on 17.12.2018 he was going coming towards Living Style Mall from the side of Jasola Red Light and when he reached on Service Road near Living Style Mall, offending vehicle, which was driven by its driver in rash and negligent manner came from back side and hit the said motorcycle due to which he fell down and sustained injuries. He was immediately removed to Sanjivani Hospital and from where he was referred to Aiims Trauma Center by ambulance. Mact No.: 243/19 Sayed Md. Hussain Vs. Darsan Mandal & Anr. Page No. 2 of 21 rp :3: 4. The police after investigation in present case filed charge sheet for offence u/s 279, 338 Ipc and 146, 196 of Mv Act against the respondent no.1. Present Dar was also filed by the investigating officer. 5. In this case, there was no third party insurance of such offending vehicle. 6. Further as per record, R-1 & 2 both initially appeared and filed their separate reply. In nutshell, in reply, they stated that R-1 has been falsely implicated in the present case and accident was occurred due to rash and negligent driving of injured himself and he could not control his motorcycle no. Up 22F 7642 and collided with the respondent's standing vehicle from the front side even respondent's vehicle was not in moving condition at that time. It is further alleged that injured was not even wearing helmet at that time. They further denied that they have any liability in the present case. They further stated that Io along with others wrongly implicated them in the present case. 7. From the material on record, the following issues were framed on 01.06.2019 by my Ld.
